entries.name: Richard Marino

expected.charges: Mutiny for joining the October 14, 1968 peaceful sit-down by prisoners at the Presidio Stockade.
expected.convicted: Yes — court-martialed for mutiny; on June 30, 1970, the Court of Military Review dismissed the mutiny charge and convicted on the lesser offense of willful disobedience.
expected.sentence: 15 months at hard labor imposed June 6, 1969; reduced on appeal to 8 months at hard labor.

entries.rationale: Congressional Record August6 1970 pp27642-27643 individual disposition table explicitly records June6 1969 sentencing. Populate structured field consistent with existing case text. Do not infer release from sentence length or appellate reduction.
